descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
SURF THE NEON COSMOS AT LIGHTSPEED!

Hop on your anti-grav hoverboard and carve through a procedurally generated 
metropolis suspended in deep space. Dodge high-voltage laser gates, hurdle energy 
barriers, and bank across 3 high-speed sky-rails in pure adrenaline flow.

⚡ PURE ADRENALINE FLOW
   Instant-response rail hopping and ducking designed for zero VR motion sickness.

🌌 ENDLESS CYBER SKYLINES
   Race through an evolving space canyon with procedural skyscrapers, stardust mist, 
   and deep-space nebulas.

🛹 CUSTOMIZE YOUR RIDE
   Collect golden Stardust to unlock sleek hoverboards, cyber visors, and neon particle trails.

🎧 PULSING SYNTH RETROWAVE
   Fully dynamic audio that pulses to the speed and intensity of your run.

*Comfort Rating: Comfortable (Engineered with stable horizon physics for all VR players).*
